manifest.scientific_question: Does preserving every positive final child-RMP route within the same 512-route component caps reveal useful parent-pool complementarity that the first length/cost selector discarded?

proof_scope.pool_construction: data-only parent-ID remap preserving integer witnesses and final child-RMP positive support; no new optimization, parent CG certificate, parent full-model LP bound, or parent graph
proof_scope.mip: finite constructed pool only; physical replay of every admitted route; a 32-bus incumbent proves baseline feasibility, while a value above 32 does not prove 32 impossible
proof_scope.independence: 46 MIPs are treatment comparisons on one parent instance, not 46 independent instances

selection.mandatory: every source-MIP selected trip set and every positive final child-RMP trip set; cheapest same-trip-set payload retained
selection.fill: longest route, cheapest cost/trip, stable parent IDs
selection.mandatory_over_cap: retain all mandatory routes and report actual count

resource_policy.reason: 46 independent eligible solver cases is below default cap 50
